title: 第二十五章 伪友探深浅入局锁暗踪第二十六章 顺线揪余孽旧宗秘事浮
lines: 入夜，沉沉暮色覆满京城。
街巷灯火次第亮起，看似繁华安稳的皇城内里，早已被细密的暗流层层浸透。
丞相府高墙肃穆，内外暗卫隐于廊角树影之间，呼吸敛尽，无声值守。经历白日层层布防，整座府邸固若金汤，连一只飞虫都难以随意出入。
汀兰院烛火暖柔，却照不彻室内紧绷的气氛。
沈清鸢临窗静坐，指尖轻轻抵着贴身藏玉的衣襟。柳氏死前那句“玉非宝，血为根”，始终盘旋在心间，字字惊心。
她终于彻底知晓，自己从来不是无端卷入纷争。
从生母隐姓埋名落户沈家开始，从那枚墨玉玉佩代代传承开始，这一场横跨数十年的追捕与躲藏，早已命中注定。
只是前世，无人告知、无人护她，她懵懂赴死，沦为棋局弃子。
今生，迷雾层层剥开，她手握先机，再不会任人摆布。
萧聿辞坐在一旁，指尖翻着暗卫递来的密报，墨色眼眸沉冷如渊。
“今日整日探查，潜入京城的暗阁探子多达三十余人，全部隐匿市井，不闹事、不刺探军情，唯独只查两件事——你生母当年旧事，以及墨玉玉佩的下落。”
他们目标精准，只为血脉与信物而来。
沈清鸢抬眸，轻声道：“他们不敢强攻相府。一来忌惮你的兵权势力，二来尚未确定血脉是否真的落在我身上，不敢彻底撕破脸面。如今只敢暗中试探，伺机窥探。”
暗阁百年底蕴，最善隐忍布局，从不打无把握之仗。
萧聿辞颔首：“所以他们一定会派人登门。假意攀亲叙旧，实则摸底试探。”
话音刚落，院外管事快步入内，神色恭谨又带着几分谨慎：
“王爷，大小姐，府门外来了一位素衣文士，自称是当年主母的旧识故人，漂泊多年归京，特来拜祭主母，想要拜见大小姐。”
来了。
两人对视一眼，眼底皆是了然的清冷。
天下哪有这般凑巧的故人。
蛰伏十几年毫无音讯，偏偏在柳氏身死、暗阁浮出水面的关键时刻，千里归来登门。
分明是暗阁精心挑选的使者，伪装故人，前来探局。
萧聿辞淡淡开口：“传他进来。全程监视，不许触碰府中一物，不许独处半步。”
不多时，一道清瘦儒雅的身影缓步踏入汀兰院。
男子三十出头，素衫布衣，眉目温和，气质清雅，看着便是满腹诗书的文客模样，挑不出半分破绽。他躬身行礼，眉眼间带着恰到好处的缅怀与谦恭。
“晚生苏文，年少时曾蒙沈主母善意照拂，多年流落异乡，今日归京，特来拜祭故人，探望大小姐。”
礼数周全，言辞恳切，若是寻常闺阁女子，定然会全然相信。
可沈清鸢历经两世风波，早已看透所有伪装皮囊。她唇角噙着浅淡笑意，眼底却无半分暖意，淡淡回礼：“先生远道而来，有心了。”
苏文目光看似随意扫过庭院，实则视线隐秘游走，细细探查她周身气息，搜寻玉佩踪迹，嘴上温和闲谈：
“当年主母品性温良，仁善通透，可惜天不假年，实在令人惋惜。不知大小姐这些年，可还留存主母贴身的旧物？”
开门见山，直奔核心。
沈清鸢心底冷然，面上依旧从容淡然，轻轻摇头：“母亲旧物繁多，书卷、首饰、衣物皆有留存，只是年代久远，大多封存库房，未曾细细整理。”
她虚实相间，不承认、不否认，故意不接玉佩的话头，引对方沉不住气。
苏文眸光微闪，不肯罢休，再度试探：
“晚生记得最清楚，主母常年贴身佩戴一枚墨玉吊坠，那是她最珍视的信物，据说能护身避祸。不知那枚玉佩，如今可还在？晚生恰好知晓些许玉佩渊源，或可为大小姐解惑。”
终于主动道出玉佩。
一旁静坐的萧聿辞缓缓抬眸，清冷目光落在苏文身上，语调闲散，却带着碾压一切的威压：
“先生既是拜祭故人，便谈故人情谊便可。区区一枚配饰，何至于再三追问？”
突如其来的质问，让苏文身形微僵。
他方才所有注意力都落在沈清鸢身上，竟全然忽略了身旁气场凛冽的摄政王。心头骤然一紧，伪装的儒雅温和裂开一丝缝隙。
苏文连忙收敛心神，拱手笑道：“王爷说笑了，只是旧物寄情，一时感慨罢了。”
“感慨？”
萧聿辞微微抬眼，字字锋利，直穿伪装，“暗阁蛰伏世人，何时也学会了这般藏头露尾、假意温情的把戏？”
content_en:
At night, twilight enveloped the capital.
The lights in the streets lit up one after another, and the seemingly prosperous and peaceful imperial city was already permeated by subtle undercurrents.
The high walls of the Prime Minister's Mansion are solemn, and the internal and external secret guards are hidden among the shadows of the trees in the corners of the corridors, holding their breath and keeping watch silently. After being fortified throughout the day, the entire mansion was so impregnable that not even a flying insect could enter or leave at will.
The candlelight in Tinglan Courtyard was warm and soft, but it could not illuminate the tense atmosphere in the room.
Shen Qingyuan sat quietly by the window, her fingertips gently touching the skirt of Zangyu's clothes. Liu's words before his death, "Jade is not a treasure, blood is its root" have always been lingering in my heart, and every word is shocking.
She finally fully understood that she had never been involved in conflicts for no reason.
From the moment the biological mother settled in the Shen family anonymously, from the time the black jade pendant was passed down from generation to generation, this pursuit and hiding that spanned decades was already doomed.
But in her previous life, no one told her or protected her, so she died in ignorance and became an abandoned piece in the chess game.
In this life, the layers of fog are peeling away. She has the opportunity and will never be manipulated by others again.
Xiao Yuci sat aside, flipping through the secret report sent by the secret guard with his fingertips, his dark eyes as cold as abyss.
"We have been investigating all day today. There are as many as thirty secret agents who have sneaked into the capital. They are all hiding in the city. They are not making trouble or spying on military affairs. They are only looking for two things - the past events of your biological mother and the whereabouts of the black jade pendant."
Their goals are precise and they only come for blood and tokens.
Shen Qingyuan raised his eyes and said softly: "They don't dare to attack the Prime Minister's Mansion. Firstly, they are afraid of your military power, and secondly, they have not yet determined whether the bloodline really belongs to me, so they dare not completely break up. Now they only dare to test in secret and wait for an opportunity to spy."
An Pavilion has a century-old heritage and is the best at forbearing and forbearing, never fighting an uncertain battle.
Xiao Yuci nodded: "So they will definitely send someone to visit. Pretending to get married and reminiscing about old times, they are actually testing the situation."
As soon as he finished speaking, the steward quickly walked in with a respectful and cautious expression:
"Your Majesty, the eldest lady, a scholar in plain clothes came outside the house. He claimed to be an old acquaintance of the mistress. He had been wandering for many years and returned to the capital. He came here to pay homage to the mistress and wanted to see the eldest lady."
Coming.
The two of them looked at each other with clear coldness in their eyes.
How can there be such a coincidental old friend in the world?
After dormant for more than ten years, there was no news, but at the critical moment when Liu died and the secret pavilion surfaced, he came back from thousands of miles away.
He was clearly an envoy carefully selected by the Ange, pretending to be an old friend, and came to explore the situation.
Xiao Yuci said calmly: "Tell him to come in. Monitor him the whole time. He is not allowed to touch anything in the house, and he is not allowed to be alone for even half a step."
"Yes."
Not long after, a thin and elegant figure slowly stepped into Tinglan Courtyard.
The man is in his early thirties, wearing plain clothes, with gentle eyebrows and an elegant temperament. He looks like a scholar who is full of poems and books, and he can't find any flaws. He bowed and saluted, with the right amount of nostalgia and humility in his eyebrows.
"Su Wen was born late. He was kindly taken care of by Mistress Shen when he was young. He has been living in a foreign land for many years. He returned to Beijing today and came here to pay homage to his old friend and visit the eldest lady."
The etiquette is thorough and the words are sincere. If you are an ordinary boudoir woman, you will definitely believe it.
But Shen Qingyuan has experienced two turmoils in his life and has already seen through all the disguises. There was a faint smile on the corner of her lips, but there was no warmth in her eyes. She responded lightly: "Sir, you have come all the way from afar. You are very considerate."
Su Wen's eyes seemed to be casually sweeping across the courtyard, but in fact his eyes were wandering secretly, carefully exploring the aura around her body, searching for traces of the jade pendant, and chatting gently:
"Back then, my mistress was gentle and kind, but it's a pity that the New Year is not celebrated. I wonder if the eldest lady has kept any of my mistress's personal belongings in these years?"
Get straight to the point and get to the heart of it.
Shen Qingyuan's heart was cold, but his face remained calm and indifferent, and he shook his head gently: "My mother has many old things, including books, jewelry, and clothes. It's just that it's been a long time, and most of them have been sealed in warehouses and have not been sorted out carefully."
She alternated between falsehood and truth, neither admitting nor denying, and deliberately did not answer Yupei's words, making the other party unable to calm down.
Su Wen's eyes flashed slightly and he refused to give up, testing again:
"Wansheng remembers it most clearly. The mistress wears a black jade pendant close to her body all year round. It is her most cherished token. It is said to be able to protect herself and avoid disasters. I wonder if that jade pendant is still there today? Wansheng happens to know a little bit about the origin of the jade pendant, which may be able to clear up the eldest lady's doubts."
Finally took the initiative to reveal the jade pendant.
Xiao Yuci, who was sitting quietly on the side, slowly raised his eyes, his cold gaze fell on Su Wen, his tone was casual, but with overwhelming pressure:
"Sir, since you are paying homage to an old friend, you can just talk about our friendship. It's just an accessory, why bother asking again and again?"
The sudden question made Su Wen stiffen slightly.
All his attention was focused on Shen Qingyuan just now, and he completely ignored the regent with a strong aura beside him. My heart suddenly tightened, and there was a crack in the pretense of elegance and gentleness.
Su Wen quickly calmed down, cupped his hands and said with a smile: "The prince is joking, it's just an old thing to express feelings for, and it's just a moment of emotion."
"Sentimental?"
Xiao Yuci raised his eyes slightly, and his words were sharp and pierced through the disguise, "When did the people in the dark pavilion learn to hide their heads and tails and pretend to be warm?"
title_en: Chapter 25: Fake friends probe into the situation to lock down the secret trail Chapter 26: Follow the thread to uncover the remaining evildoers and the secrets of the old sect come to light
